findings.title: Article save can undo a successful publish
findings.reproduction: Edit an existing draft; let auto-save start; publish before save settles; allow publish to commit before the older update. The toast says published while the row ends as draft.

findings.title: Overlapping saves can create duplicate new articles
findings.reproduction: Type a new title, click Save as the auto-save timer fires, and keep both create responses pending. Both calls can submit with a null article ID.

findings.title: Failed event detail request leaves a permanent loading spinner
findings.reproduction: Open an event detail URL while its GET returns an error; after the query settles the spinner remains, with no retry action.

findings.confidence: high for state flow; browser confirmation needed for normal route reuse
findings.title: Briefing cards can cross event IDs when detail component is reused
findings.reproduction: Keep the event detail component mounted while changing route ID A to B, then save B's Briefing tab. A's local cards are sent to B.
